name: Inclusive Experience Repair Engine

canonical.title: Inclusive Experience Simulator & Repair Lab
canonical.job: Experience and repair an interface under different access, device, bandwidth, motion, color, language and cognitive conditions.
canonical.bWeb: An interface transforms live under constraints, then the visitor repairs it.

nonClaims: Interface conditions do not simulate a person, disability, culture, cognition, language community, device, network, or lived experience.
Mapped controls do not prove repair efficacy, usability, accessibility, localization quality, WCAG conformance, or legal compliance.
Manual participant, assistive-technology, physical-device, language, and network testing remains required.
